BiblicalUsage: Sarai said, it may be that I may obtain children by Hagar, and Moses went up the mount saying, peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe perhaps is an honest word in Scripture: Sarai's perhaps led to trouble and Moses' peradventure led to prayer, and the difference was never the word but where the hope was placed.
